domain_specific_rationale: From an observability and cost-tracking perspective, the two-phase credit settlement protocol (Phase 1 reservation upon queueing, Phase 2 settlement upon terminal execution/QC completion or release on failure) provides deterministic financial lifecycle states that can be tracked with OTel metrics (credit.reserved, credit.settled, credit.released, credit.refunded). Correlating credit transactions with generation_job_id, shot_id, and trace_id enables precise real-time cost attribution, financial reconciliation dashboards, and alerting on unreleased reservations or budget anomalies.
capability_impact: Supports CAP-14 (Platform Observability) cost tracking and preserves CAP-02 (Deterministic State Persistence) and CAP-08 (Resource/Cost Accounting).
residual_risk: Unreleased reservations due to orphaned jobs or aborted workflows could skew credit metrics and billing analytics if not monitored. Mitigate with reservation TTL alerts, stuck-job metric counters, and automated reconciliation sweeps monitored by R14 dashboards.
